4. After diagnosis, test one change at a time. Repeat the same workload and compare dropped frames.

task_runs.prompt: A React Native animation stutters when the JavaScript thread is busy. Give a short diagnosis plan and cite any local files you use. Do not edit files or use the network.
task_runs.final:
Check whether each animation frame depends on the JavaScript thread. The symptom alone does not confirm the cause.

1. Repeat the same animation with JavaScript idle and busy. Use a release build. Record frame times for both threads. See [performance guidance](.agents/skills/animations/animations-performance.md).
2. Check the animation driver. For core `Animated`, check `useNativeDriver` and property support. For Reanimated, check that frame updates use UI-thread worklets. Look for React state updates or JavaScript callbacks on each frame. See [animation guidance](.agents/skills/callstack-react-native-best-practices/references/js-animations-reanimated.md).
3. Profile the busy interval. Find long JavaScript tasks and repeated React renders. If UI frames also slow down, check heavy worklets and layout changes. See [profiling guidance](.agents/skills/callstack-react-native-best-practices/SKILL.md).
4. Test one suspected cause at a time. Repeat the same measurement after each change. Confirm that the original stutter stops. See [diagnosis procedure](/Users/tudor/.agents/skills/diagnosing-bugs/SKILL.md).
